theme_and_archetype.vibe: Ivy League Cyber / Old Money Tech. The platform must feel like an authoritative, prestigious certification body for Fortune 500 companies, utilizing a serious tech-editorial aesthetic rather than a generic SaaS look.

rules: Never use bold (font-bold) for Cormorant Garamond headings; use font-medium or font-semibold to retain elegance.
Always use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headings.
Use IBM Plex Mono for course tags, code snippets, and certificate IDs.
Embrace asymmetrical grids for the marketing landing page (e.g., col-span-8 paired with col-span-4).
Use strict, dense grids for the learner dashboard and course module lists.
Containers with borders MUST have generous internal padding (p-8 minimum) to avoid text collision.

surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 (light) or bg-[#05070D]/80 (dark) with a 1px delicate bottom border.
surface_strategies.cards: Flat solid background with 1px sharp border (border-border). No default drop shadows. On hover, apply a slight -translate-y-1 and a subtle diffuse shadow.
surface_strategies.premium_certificates: The 'Tracing Beam' effect. Outline the certificate cards with a subtle animated gradient border to signal high value and verification.
surface_strategies.ai_tutor_panel: Neumorphic/Clay hybrid: Soft ambient shadow with a sharp 1px inner border. Differentiates the AI interaction layer from the flat content layer.

buttons.primary: bg-accent-primary text-white hover:bg-accent-hover rounded-sm px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-accent-secondary text-white hover:bg-black rounded-sm px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors (Light Mode)
buttons.outline: border border-border hover:border-accent-primary text-text-primary rounded-sm px-6 py-3 transition-colors

component_patterns.badges: px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-none border border-border text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider bg-surface-alt
component_patterns.course_modules: List layout with border-b border-border py-4. Hover state adds a very subtle bg-surface-alt shift.
component_patterns.progress_bars: H-1 bg-surface-alt rounded-none overflow-hidden. Fill is accent-primary.
component_patterns.forms: Use Shadcn inputs but force rounded-sm or rounded-none. Focus states must ring with accent-primary, not default blue.
component_patterns.data_testid: ALL interactive components MUST include a kebab-case data-testid (e.g., data-testid='enroll-button').

hero_backgrounds.description: High-raise architectural library, use for main academy hero background with a bg-black/40 overlay to ensure text contrast.
Modern campus building, use for Enterprise/B2B landing page sections.

course_thumbnails.description: Blue abstract network lines, use for 'Introduction to Agentic AI' course.
Stacked cubes, use for 'Advanced LLM Architecture' course.

corporate_learners.description: Diverse professionals collaborating, use for 'For Teams/Business' sections.
Professionals discussing documents, use for testimonials or case studies.

company_logos.description: OpenAI screen, use in a tech partner or 'Powered by' banner.
Palantir logo, use as a placeholder for enterprise customers in trust banner.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts: Cormorant Garamond (400,500,600), IBM Plex Sans (400,500,600), and IBM Plex Mono.
Configure tailwind.config.js to use these exact color hex codes and font families.
Do NOT use generic Shadcn Cards without removing their heavy default drop shadows. Replace with the 1px sharp border style.
Implement the landing page using raw HTML/Tailwind to allow for asymmetrical bento grids. Use Shadcn only for interactive bits (forms, dialogs, accordion).
Ensure all text over images (like the hero section) has at least bg-black/40 overlay or strong text-shadow for WCAG AA compliance.
For the AI Tutor chat interface, position it as a fixed bottom-right floating panel with 'Crystal Glassmorphism' to keep the course content visible beneath it.
All navigation links and buttons must have explicit :hover state color changes.
Add data-testid attributes to all form inputs, buttons, course cards, and navigation items.
